rationale: Lenses materially disagree on whether the mutual hedging is performed indifference protecting against asymmetric investment, or genuinely casual low-stakes contact; both readings are evidenced and no utterance disambiguates them, so this needs a human read plus the systemic lens's probe before any single story is treated as settled.

dissent.note: Reads the hedging pattern as a strong, consistent protective signal across both participants and would promote the performed-indifference reading as the primary account.
The observable layer alone shows only vague, unscheduled language on both sides; without a probe this stays underdetermined and should park rather than resolve toward either story.
